cards.question: What is the default storage modifier for visibility in C?
When is auto storage acquired and freed?
cards.answer: Memory is acquired when the variable comes into scope and freed when it goes out of scope. Lifetime is bound to scope.

cards.question: When do you need to write the auto keyword?
cards.answer: You do not, unless you are shadowing a global variable and want to be specific about the shadowing.
